headline: Gaza Health Ministry toll since the ceasefire reaches 1,599 killed
dek: Israeli strikes on Nov 3 killed at least four Palestinians in Gaza, including a Hamas internal-security member (Mohammed Shalouf, killed in al-Mawasi, west of Khan Younis) and a teenage girl (killed in a drone strike on a tent near Gaza Municipality Park, central Gaza City); three more were killed…
sources: Gaza Health Ministry / medical sources via WAFA, reported by Arab News, Haaretz and Anadolu Agency
fault_line: Ceasefire on paper or war by another name -- does a toll of 1,599 dead since the truce mean the ceasefire has collapsed, or is it still holding as a framework while strikes continue?
